guidance.topic: H2 FY26 large-scale utility RE addition
guidance.said: The company planned to execute another 1.3 gigawatts for the full year large-scale utility.
guidance.quote: So, we have added about 205 megawatts in H1 and as Dr. Sinha mentioned earlier, we have planned to execute another 1.3. So, for the full year, you will see about 1.5 on the large-scale utility.

business: Tata Power Company Limited generates, transmits, and distributes electricity, and manufactures solar cells and modules. Its main segments include power generation (thermal and renewable), transmission, distribution (including discoms in Odisha and Delhi), rooftop solar, and solar manufacturing.
